# Contributing to BookWorm

🎉 Thank you for your interest in contributing to **BookWorm**!

BookWorm is a cloud-native microservices application showcasing Aspire, Domain-Driven Design, Vertical Slice Architecture, and AI integration. We welcome contributions of all kinds—bug fixes, features, tests, and documentation improvements.

## Developer Onboarding & Guidelines

All environment setup, development workflow, engineering standards, testing, and pull request guidelines live in our documentation:

👉 **[Developer Onboarding Guide](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/001-developer-onboarding)**

1. **[Getting Started](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/002-getting-started)** — Prerequisites, cloning, and local environment setup
2. **[Development Workflow](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/003-development-workflow)** — Branching, `mise` tasks, and making changes
3. **[Engineering Standards](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/004-engineering-standards)** — Architecture, C#, frontend, event, and Protobuf conventions
4. **[Testing](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/005-testing)** — Unit, architecture, contract, and frontend test practices
5. **[Pull Request Process](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/development/006-pull-request-process)** — Preparing, submitting, and reviewing PRs

Please follow the onboarding guide above before opening a pull request so your changes pass pre-commit hooks and CI validation smoothly.

## Ways to Contribute

- **Report a bug:** Open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml).
- **Request a feature:** Open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/issues/new?template=feature-request.yml).
- **Report an accessibility issue:** Open an [Accessibility Issue](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml) (see [ACCESSIBILITY.md](ACCESSIBILITY.md)).
- **Ask questions or share ideas:** Start a thread in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/discussions).
- **Submit a pull request:** Fill out [pull_request_template.md](pull_request_template.md) with a clear title and description explaining *what* changed and *why*.

## Community & Policies

- **Code of Conduct:** All contributors are expected to follow [CODE-OF-CONDUCT.md](CODE-OF-CONDUCT.md).
- **Security:** Do **not** report security vulnerabilities through public issues—follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
